name: Ramp turn 90 deg, 3 m path, 0.5 -> 1.0 m

joins.grid: pivot bottom centre of the 6 x 6 m footprint; L-shaped 3 m wide path, turns 90 deg left (from +Y to -X); bottom flat at z=0
joins.low_end: flat face y = -3.0, x 0..+3 (centre x = +1.5), walk top z = 0.50
joins.high_end: flat face x = -3.0, y 0..+3 (centre y = +1.5), walk top z = 1.00
joins.chain: AN07 straight ramp (3 m wide) meets the low end when placed at (+1.5, -5, -0.5) [its 1.0 m high end -> 0.5]; at the high end continue with AN07 rotated 90 deg (rising toward -X) placed at (-5, +1.5, +0.97) on an earth base, or a landing at z = 1.0. Mirror in X for a right turn.

notes: L-shaped earth block with a 45-deg chamfer on the inside corner and a square outer corner; Floor top rises evenly along the path, rounded Earth lips, crooked bulging sides, no steps.
